scope: One 20 ms candidate segment followed by a fixed common-cruise backup; prescribed independent synthetic states, not a fleet closed-loop simulation or aircraft validation
frame: world Cartesian, z up; zero wind, ground velocity equals air-relative velocity; chi is air-path azimuth, gamma is flight-path inclination, not body attitude

fixed_wing_model.identity: sampled constrained airspeed-airpath kinematics, declared research execution model
fixed_wing_model.update: For x=s,chi,gamma: x_next=x+clip(h*e/tau,-h*a,h*a); e_chi is wrapped to [-pi,pi); command s and gamma are clipped to the fixed envelope before prediction
fixed_wing_model.segment: s,chi,gamma interpolate linearly between their discrete endpoints; v=s*(cos(gamma)*cos(chi),cos(gamma)*sin(chi),sin(gamma)); r integrates this v. This segment definition, not Euler/trapezoid position, is used in both execution prediction and certification.
fixed_wing_model.parameter_provenance: 15 m/s is the user cap. Other FW numbers are prospective research assumptions, not measured Bixler parameters. They are fixed before this check, not calibrated against pass counts. The 2 m/s2 limit is longitudinal speed rate, not the old vector acceleration cap.
fixed_wing_model.physical_scope: Minimum speed, speed slew, airpath turn rate, inclination and inclination slew are enforced. No body-roll dynamics, lift/drag, thrust, stall/load-factor certification or wind model. A level-turn equivalent bank is descriptive only.

rotor_model.identity: unchanged historical saturated vector-velocity proxy for FPV and quadrotor
rotor_model.segment: linear velocity, quadratic position; not measured QAV250/X500 dynamics

position_integration: Complex exponential Taylor integral through degree 8 for linearly changing speed/angles; analytic remainder bounded and accumulated; independent Gauss quadrature crosscheck. The padding is a numerical allowance, not a physical uncertainty margin or interval-arithmetic proof.
continuous_pair_check: All 3160 pairs. Minimum distance on endpoint chord minus (Ai+Aj)*dt^2/8 and accumulated position allowances, where Ai bounds continuous acceleration. Refine only uncertified segments at subdivision factors 2,4,8,16,32,64 using the same continuous segment, without changing the sampled execution model. Record actual sampled violations separately from conservative/unresolved rejections.
infinite_tail: For FW: B=F(|s-9|;tau_s,a_s)+9*(F(|wrap(chi)|;tau_chi,a_chi)+F(|gamma|;tau_gamma,a_gamma)); F is the exact integrated scalar residual for the saturated discrete update with linear interpolation. For rotors use the original residual-speed path relative to b. Require all pair distances minus both B values and numerical allowances >= distance+tolerance at explicit-window end.
candidate_policy: First two branches are the minimal acceptance check: accept full P envelope-mapped candidate if certified, otherwise common cruise if certified, otherwise report no certified candidate. Legacy separation branch is diagnostic, not a proposed new safety controller. No lambda/gain search.
command_mapping: FW norm clipped to [8,15], flight-path inclination clipped to +/-10 deg, target azimuth retained; undefined zero/horizontal direction rejected. Rotors retain spherical speed cap. No further rewrite after a candidate is selected for prediction.
initial_admissibility: Check old current spacing and all speed caps, plus FW speed floor and inclination. Do not alter initial states. Retain inadmissible cases in all records but exclude them from qualified pass denominator.
verification: continuous distance enclosure against dense segment probes
data_storage: All case and branch results plus distance/time diagnostics; representative seed 1001 full profiles and all failure witness metadata. Deterministic script regenerates every profile.
stop_rules: Do not adjust parameters, task or initial conditions using outcomes
Do not call a certificate failure a collision without a trajectory witness
Do not transfer old proxy certificates to this model
No new fleet closed loop or manuscript model replacement in this check
protected: Main paper, historical data, P implementation and task configuration remain unchanged
